description: This file defines a utility class 'Utils' for handling promises in the GuzzleHttp Promise library, including methods for managing task queues, inspecting promises, waiting for multiple promises, and creating promise-based operations.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A final class providing static utility methods for promise management, including queue handling, promise inspection, aggregation, and race conditions.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Gets or sets the global task queue used for promise resolution.

methods.name: task
methods.description: Adds a task to the queue and returns a promise that resolves or rejects based on task execution.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Synchronously inspects a promise, returning its state, value, or rejection reason.

methods.name: inspectAll
methods.description: Inspects multiple promises, returning an array of their inspection states.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Waits on multiple promises and returns their fulfilled values, throwing on rejection.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled when all input promises are fulfilled, or rejects if any reject.

methods.name: some
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled when a specified number of promises are fulfilled, or rejects if not enough fulfill.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled with the first fulfilled promise's value.

methods.name: settle
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled with an array of inspection states for all input promises.
